subject: Your {productName} password was changed
preheader: If this was you, no action is needed.
body: The password for your {productName} account was just set or changed. If this was you, no action is needed. If you did not do this, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page straight away to take back control, and tell your administrator.
footer: You are receiving this because password changes on your account are always confirmed by email.
